label: Module tilt
basis: Floating arrays are typically low tilt. Held fixed; build reports yield at 5 and 15 deg as a sensitivity.

label: Module azimuth
basis: North-facing assumed for a southern-hemisphere site. An east-west layout would change the daily shape; not modelled.

label: Ground coverage ratio (row spacing)
basis: Floating arrays are packed densely; no Cirata layout data. Higher GCR = more row shading.

label: Row width (module slant length)
basis: Sets row pitch together with GCR; layout not verified.

label: Module height above water
basis: Typical pontoon float height; only affects rear-side light.

label: Bifaciality factor
basis: Module model not verified. Low = monofacial; mid/high = typical glass-glass bifacial.

label: Share of surface under array that is float, not water
basis: Float design not verified. Floats are lighter than water, raising rear-side light.

label: Float surface albedo
basis: White HDPE floats; no measured value found, so wide range.

label: Module heat-loss coefficient (cooling)
basis: Low = PVsyst free-standing land default (no water cooling credit). Dorenkamper et al. 2021 (Solar Energy 214) report FPV heat-loss coefficients higher than land systems, smaller in the low-wind tropics than in temperate sites; values recalled from the paper, not re-checked, so the range is deliberately wide.

label: Power temperature coefficient
basis: Typical range for PERC to TOPCon/HJT datasheets; module model not verified.

label: Soiling loss (dust, bird droppings)
basis: Heavy rain washes panels, but bird droppings are a known FPV issue; no Cirata data.

label: Mismatch, DC wiring and wave motion
basis: Typical design-tool defaults widened for float movement.

label: Light-induced and nameplate loss
basis: Typical design-tool range.

label: Availability (uptime)
basis: No outage data published. Grid curtailment is NOT modelled.

label: Inverter nominal efficiency
basis: Inverter details not verified; typical central/string inverter range.

label: AC loss to export point (transformers, cables)
basis: Typical range; grid connection details not verified.

label: Module degradation
basis: Typical warranty-level range.

label: Extra degradation from humid over-water environment
basis: No reliable published value found; placeholder range covering zero to a pessimistic extra.

label: Electricity sale price (PPA tariff)
basis: Commonly quoted near 5.8 US cents/kWh in press; not verified here.

label: Capital cost
basis: Widely reported order of US$100-130 million; not verified.

label: Household electricity use
basis: Indonesian household consumption not verified; wide range. Low end of 'homes powered' uses the highest use.

label: Java-Bali grid emission factor
basis: Coal-heavy grid; official factor not verified here.

label: DC capacity
basis: plant_facts

label: AC capacity (export limit)
basis: plant_facts

label: Location (dam point)
basis: Coordinates are the Cirata hydro dam; the array may sit a few km away, so the location is approximate.

label: Altitude
basis: Assumed approximate reservoir surface level; affects only air pressure in the clear-sky and sun-position calculations.

label: Water surface type for albedo
basis: Reservoir assumed greenish with small ripples (Dvoracek & Hannabas 1990 categories).

label: Inauguration to June 2024
basis: pln_nr (high reliability). Primary source, cumulative. End taken as 30 June 2024. Unknown whether pre-inauguration commissioning output is included.

label: Cumulative to mid-Nov 2024
basis: secondary_2024 (medium reliability). Secondary report; 'mid-November' taken as 15 Nov 2024.

label: Calendar 2024
basis: secondary_2024 (medium reliability). Secondary report. Conflicts slightly with the AGM figure below.

label: AGM 2025 figure (probably 2024)
basis: agm_2025 (medium reliability). Year not stated in the report; assumed to be calendar 2024.
